product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for business, technology and analytics teams that captures customer behavior, detects digital friction and errors, and helps prioritize improvements to web and mobile experiences.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes custom plans; numeric prices are not required for this classification.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn-reported band. The official website instead says '500+ employees', so the public sources disagree.

eng_blog.notes: Its main blog includes technical posts by Senior Solutions Engineer Skyler Bailey explaining the MCP server architecture and a friction-data-to-coding-agent proof of concept.

public_docs.notes: No public multi-article documentation portal was found. The docs hostname serves marketing content, the help hostname exposes no readable help articles, and Quantum Metric University provides a course catalogue rather than public documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers list contains no opening with a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Felix Agentic combines Gemini with Quantum Metric's proprietary data, knowledge layer and analytical workflows.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC2 +HITRUST attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification and GDPR compliance. HIPAA and PCI references concern customers' compliance, not Quantum Metric's own certifications.

last_funding.notes: Announced January 7, 2021; the funding history reviewed identifies this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was January 2021, before the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Strategic Account Executive, BFSI posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 16, 2026, announced Summer 2026 capabilities, including general availability of Felix Agentic and new mobile crash analytics and AI-driven traffic capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Dan Villano's profile dates his Interim Chief Financial Officer role to January 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in the VP, Global Growth Marketing posting as desired marketing-stack familiarity; this is a hiring signal, not confirmation that every system is deployed internally.
